SMT - SMART Monitor Terminal                                                                                                     M 1501 404 E-EN-2016-02



















Product Features:
       Multi-touch monitor1 with SMART platform embedded

       Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n hotspot
       Industrial PC with Linux embedded
       Ethernet, Profibus and wireless 3G2 interface
       SIBRE bus interfaces (up to 4) for SDT

       IP55 & marine painting enclosure





Product Specifications:

                                           Display     LCD multitouch; 16:9 format ; 1920x1080 resolution
     System                            Processor       Intel i3 or higher
 Specification                Operative System         Linux based

                                          Storage      128GB SSD or higher

                                         Profibus      Profibus DP (optional)
   Interfaces                            Ethernet      10-100-1000Base-T
                                         Wireless      3G or 4G (optional)
                                              WiFi     Wi-Fi hotspot (802.11 a/b/g) (802.11n: 2.4 GHz)
                                         Profibus      DB9 connector
  Connection                             Ethernet      RJ45
                                   Power Supply        Terminal box with 3 poles with cable gland M16 (0,75 - 1,5 mm2 range)

     Power                           Power input       230Vac (110Vac optional)
    Manager                Power Consumption           225W aprox. (under full loading)

                                     Dimensions        555 x 325 x 367 mm (W x L x H)
                                           Weight      20 kg

                                        Mounting       Wall-fixed. 6xM8x40mm screw
 Mechanical &                             Painting     Marine painting 160u. RAL 7035 structure powder coating.
 Enviromental
                        Operation Temperature          0ºC to 40°C / 32ºF to 104°F
                            Operation Humidity         20%-80% RH
                                          IP proof     IP55
                                         Version1      SMT-R: Rack version
                                                       SMT-S: Stand version
    Optional                                           3G/4G wireless communication
                                Communication2         Profibus DP

                                                       Second profibus interface for SIBRE SLP or other device
